title: Star Magic eyes collab with Chinoy pageant to cast winners in vertical shorts
summary: Riding on the rise of vertical series followings among mobile phone users, the inaugural Mr. and Ms. Chinatown Global Philippines will have its winners appear in their own “microdramas”…

blocks.text: Riding on the rise of vertical series followings among mobile phone users, the inaugural Mr. and Ms. Chinatown Global Philippines will have its winners appear in their own “microdramas” to take a slice of the ballooning audience pie. Chinoy TV has partnered with ABS-CBN’s Star Magic for the first edition of the national competition, that took advantage of the “Star Hunt” nationwide search platform to gather candidates.
